name: Pre-commit quality gate
description: Manually runs the standard quality gate (build, lint, and the full test suite) on demand and summarizes whether the change is ready to commit. This hook is user-triggered only: it fires solely when you click its button in the Kiro Agent Hooks panel. It has no automatic trigger, so it never runs on its own or consumes credits unattended.

then.prompt: Run the pre-commit quality gate from the workspace root: `npm run build`, then `npm run lint`, then `npm test` (which already passes vitest --run). Report a concise PASS or FAIL summary for each step, and name the first failure if any step fails. Do not modify any files.
